author: xLayyton
body:
Name: FnS_RedX [reason for ban?] Xray, Killaura, regeneration 
Guilty: Yes
Reason why we should un-ban you?

You know all my things have got denied my latest one was banned for Ban evading Which i changed my name for personal and security reasons its not a new account its just a name change. 

Yes, they did have proof of me hacking and after that day i wasn't mad at my self but all the people i hurt while hacking and to that day i have stopped using hacks and I've really cleaned up my act. Avicus was my life in mine craft i have a passion for pvp and i even helped ParaSpider on one of the maps. I know i did the wrong thing and it was one of the worst choices of my life but i know not everything is a second chance but i hope today you guys understand i wouldn't be writing this if i truly wasn't sorry for my actions. Avicus was my only server i ever played on and no other servers are like it even OCTC is alot different and i liked Avicus because of all my friends on it and overall just having a great time with the community im very sorry for my immature grammar. Let's just say before i got banned i thought hacking was cool and i followed my friends. After that incident i got rid of those friends and searched up on YouTube how to get rid of hacks. As you guys should know my .minecraft file is now spic and span and i swear in my heart if i do hack again which i promise not too.I will not appeal because i know i made the wrong choice again and it's my fault and there will be no more chances. Your mods,helpers,admins and all staff ranks are very good at what they do you picked the right staff members to put on your server.
They were always so kind and talking with the community and i feel truly sorry for i made them do i shouldn't of hacked in the first place it was a stupid-stupid-stupid mistake and i hope one day i will be forgiven and granted the honor to join back on the Avicus.

I wish you guys a happy holidays and a great new year.   -FnS_RedX- A stupid moron that won't do stupid things again~~!!!
